description: This file defines a PHP class 'CommandTestDataGenerator' in the namespace 'Reconmap\Database'. The class is responsible for generating test data commands related to security and network scanning tools, inserting them into a repository. It contains a run() method that creates multiple Command objects with specific parameters and inserts them via the CommandRepository.

classes.name: CommandTestDataGenerator
classes.description: A read-only class responsible for generating and inserting test command data related to security and network tools.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Creates several Command objects with preset parameters and inserts them into the repository, effectively seeding test data for various commands.
